metaDescription: Order custom pocketed chef wear in bulk. Perfect for kitchens needing branded, functional uniforms with convenient pockets.
introHtml: Pocketed chef wear adds practical storage for thermometers, pens, and order pads, keeping tools within reach during service. Whether you outfit a restaurant team or a culinary school, these uniforms combine professional appearance with everyday functionality. Choose from chef coats with chest or sleeve pockets, and add your logo through embroidery or screen printing. Bulk ordering ensures consistent sizing and color matching across your staff.
